title.narrative: Health Care Services to the Most Vulnerable Groups in Rural Damascus Qudsiya Maliha

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtIn line with national health priorities and humanitarian response plan strategic objective for health in terms of increasing access to equitable health services for those most vulnerable in areas with high severity scale according to HRP 2024 Circassian charity association (CCA) aims through this project to Deliver the Essential and Comprehensive Package of Health Care Services to the Most Vulnerable Groups in Rural Damascus in Qudsiya and AL_Maliha and :ltbrgt1) increasing access to health care through the provision of comprehensive and integrated essential health services to cover the health needs of vulnerable populations, including Reproductive, Maternal, New-born, and Child Health , as well as continuity of treatment for people who live with non-communicable disease –,ltbrgt2) to reduce avoidable morbidity and mortality in Syria ltbrgt3) Expanding access to specialized services for conflict-affected populations, ltbrgt. 4) Restore, strengthen, expand health services to deliver essential package of care adapted to rapidly increasing number of consumers to provide an integrated, comprehensive basic essential health care package that addresses common diseases, and injuries, including diagnostic services at primary and secondary levels targeting the most vulnerable groups while promoting community cohesion among populations served, addressing inequalities in access to care targeting returning and receiving communities.ltbrgt5)support of public health sector locally, DoH owned and managed health facilities.ltbrgt1. Title: Deliver the Essential and Comprehensive Package of Health Care Services to the Most Vulnerable Groups in Rural Damascus in Qudsiya and AL_Maliha .ltbrgt2. Objectives/ goal: Increase access to humanitarian lifesaving and life-sustaining coordinated, equitable health services for those most vulnerable and in need, with an emphasis on high-severity and/or under-served areas with low access to health servicesltbrgtPrimary Health care:ltbrgtPHC centers ltbrgt1 Internist , 1 Gynaecologist ,1 Paediatric ,1 Pharmacist assistantltbrgt1 Nurse , 1 Health Educator , Admin AssistantltbrgtMedical mobile team ltbrgt1Internist ,1 Gynaecologist , 1 Paediatric 1 Pharmacist assistant ltbrgt1 Nurse , 1 Health Educator ,Admin Assistant and driverltbrgtBesides the following laboratories for lab tests and X-rays: Lab, D-Raeda habash Lab, Alosman lap, ltbrgt ltbrgtConsidering COVID-19 and Cholera and related precaution measuresCCA is going to conduct raising awareness sessions it will be repeated in each center 2 times a month, and each session will have about 40 beneficiaries ,also will distribute brochures about them in all centers , and procure sterilization items and distribute PPEs for the health workers to ensure their safety as well as the safety of the patients , ltbrgtSecondary and Trauma care:ltbrgtDiagnosis investigation as well as Secondary and trauma health care services will also be supported on referral basis where the referral mechanism process starts with a medical report describing the medical condition and the need for the proposed advanced treatment. The patient then is requested to fill medical aid request that contain info related to his social and economic situation to assess the vulnerability degree. Both documents are presented to the NGO committee composed of three persons : Referral Officer , project manager and NGO representative. to verify the criticality of the medical condition and the vulnerability degree that entitle the requester to receive the services free- of charge.ltbrgtRehabilitation services:ltbrgtFurthermore,CCA will provide assistive devices .lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtlt/pgt
